# GRH Web Solutions

> GRH Web Solutions is a small web design and digital studio in Erie, Pennsylvania, founded and run by Cody Hoepfl. It builds custom, hand-coded, mobile-first websites, manages social media for small businesses, and builds AI chatbots and business automations. It also offers 1-on-1 DeFi and crypto education (educational only, not financial advice). It works with clients in Erie and across the United States.

Contact: call or text 740-319-2431 · cody@grhwebsolutions.com · free quote and AI chat assistant (Webster) at https://grhwebsolutions.com/#quote

## Pricing

All website builds include basic Google SEO, schema markup and a mobile-first design. Domain names are $40 per year, paid separately. Full details: https://grhwebsolutions.com/pricing.html

- Static website (fixed pages, fast and inexpensive to host): $500 for 3 pages, $750 for 5 pages, $100 for each additional page.
- Server website (database, login or admin panel, bookings, AI chatbot): $3,000 for 5 pages, $100 for each additional page.
- E-commerce website: starting at $6,500.
- Hosting: $40 per month (SSL, speed tests, basic analytics, 1 free domain email, $10 per additional address).
- Maintenance: $125 per month (malware prevention and monitoring, security monitoring). Sites built by others: $1,000 up front, then $125 per month.
- Social media management: $125 per month per platform (posting, engagement, Google Business Profile management).
- Social media marketing: $250 per month per platform (growth strategy and paid advertising, including Google Ads). Separate from management; both on one platform is $375 per month. Platforms: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, Google, eBay. eBay marketing covers up to 250 items; 251 to 500 items is double ($500 per month). Ad spend is paid directly to the platform.
- AI chatbot: $1,500 setup plus $75 per month. Automations (lead follow-up, CRM, email and calendar): from $750 per workflow.
- iOS and Android apps: from $3,000 (priced per platform).
- DeFi education: free 15-minute consultation, then $40 per hour. Educational only, not financial advice.

Terms: 50% deposit to start, 50% when the site goes live. 3 rounds of revisions included. Redesigns are quoted separately.

Most websites launch in under two weeks.

## Services

- [Web Design in Erie, PA](https://grhwebsolutions.com/web-design-erie-pa.html): custom-designed and coded sites (no templates or page builders), mobile-first, local SEO setup, contact forms, click-to-call, e-commerce and booking.
- [Social Media Management](https://grhwebsolutions.com/social-media-management.html): content strategy and calendar, custom graphics and copywriting, scheduled posting, engagement and replies, optional Facebook and Instagram ads, monthly reports. Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn.
- [AI Chatbots and Automation](https://grhwebsolutions.com/ai-chatbots.html): website chatbots that answer questions 24/7 and email the owner the full conversation; lead follow-up, CRM, email and calendar automations.
- [DeFi Education](https://grhwebsolutions.com/defi.html): personalized sessions on wallet security, staking concepts, and navigating DEXs safely.
- [All services](https://grhwebsolutions.com/services.html)
